title: AI Director in Games
text:
What is it?
An AI director is a game system that is composed of rules that analyze the state of the gameplay in real time.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Traditional AI vs AI Director
Normally, AIs (such as NPCs) have in their code what they should be doing at the moment, perhaps they should collect an item, run away from the player, etc.
However, an AI Director does not care about what it should be doing, but instead it cares about what the situation needs.
Does the player need to relax a bit? Is the player bored? These are the type of questions the AI Director answers.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
The two Game Design concepts
This game system is based on two game design concepts:

Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi’s Flow Theory
Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Flow Theory
The Flow Theory is the idea of individuals being fully immersed by an activity (in this case, games) and experiencing full enjoyment and focus. In games, this theory is really important for player engagement.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
What keeps the players engaged?
The Flow Theory explains that the player requires a few elements to keep engagement:

Rewards (Playing feels like a reward and not a chore)
Balancing skills and challenge (to avoid too much stress or anxiety)
Progressive Difficulty as the game goes on (starts easy but gets harder)
Checkpoints (to avoid repeating a long section)

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment (DDA)
The Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment (DDA) removes the idea of the player choosing the difficulties. Instead, the game automatically adjusts itself based on the player’s performance or emotions.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
How does DDA work?
The most common DDA are performance-based systems that analyze the player’s performance such as accuracy, reaction time, and remaining health.
Does the game feel too easy? Maybe the enemies will have increased speed, damage or maybe increased spawn rate.
Does the game feel too hard? Maybe the enemies will spawn less and are slower.
Some games give you the option to change difficulty if you lose too much. This is also considered DDA, however, it is a visible DDA and not an invisible DDA.

title: AI Director in Games
section: The result of these two concepts
text:
The result of these two concepts
AI Directors are the result of mixing these two concepts. They analyze the game and adapt it based on their performance to make the game more adequate to their skills and emotions.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Left 4 Dead (game)
The most famous game that implements this game system is Left 4 Dead. In Left 4 Dead, the AI Director does not simply increase the number of enemies or their speed. Instead, it adjusts the pace and intensity of the level based on what is happening at the moment.

title: AI Director in Games
section: How AI Director changes the experiences
text:
How AI Director changes the experiences
Since Left 4 Dead’s levels are kind of short, the AI Director is perfect to avoid repetition. By playing the same level again, you may have different experiences. For example:
First time playing:
Low health and lots of missed shots -> Remove pressure by delaying enemies’ spawns and their numbers.
Second time playing:
High health and less missed shots -> Add pressure by spawning enemies more frequently with increased hordes.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Difficulty should not mean punishment
In some games, the difficulty increases as the player reaches the end of the game. However, making a game harder does not mean that it will be a better experience for the player. The purpose of a game’s difficulty increase is not to punish the player, but to instead make the game more entertaining by making it more challenging according to their skills.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Alien Isolation (game)
Alien Isolation is a game about Amanda Ripley exploring a space station while avoiding an alien (the main enemy) and other minor enemies while completing mission objectives.
As the game goes on, Amanda gets more arsenal available to fight against the alien and other enemies.
The consequence? The alien is smarter. The alien learned the player’s patterns as they played. And who’s responsible for this?

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Analyzing the Player
The AI Director was analyzing the player’s behavior this whole time.

How many times did the player enter the vents to hide?
How many times did they hide under a bed?
How many times did the player throw a lure to distract the alien?
Does the player usually go through levels fast or slow?

This system helps make the alien feel more unpredictable while making you more predictable.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Adapt
“But how is this entertaining? It just seems to make the game impossible to beat”. Well, it does not make it impossible, but it does make it harder.
There’s a simple fix for this: Adapt. Change your strategy.
This makes the player feel more engaged on the game by thinking on new ways to get through the level, instead of simply relying on old strategies.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Menace gauge
The AI Director can also affect emotions through gameplay. For example, in Alien Isolation there is a hidden gauge called “menace gauge” which checks if the player is feeling scared or overwhelmed.
Is the alien slowly walking towards the player’s position?
Is the alien in the player’s sight?
If the gauge completes, then the AI Director tells the alien to go away and give the player a chance to breathe.
As soon as the gauge gets empty, the AI Director tells the alien to go to the player’s approximate position, it never tells the player’s exact location.

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Flaws in the system
As perfect as this system sounds, it could be abused to give players free advantages.
What if the player gets themselves get hit on purpose to make the enemies weaker in the future?
What if the player is shooting at the ground on purpose to make the AI director think they are playing badly?

title: AI Director in Games
text:
Preventing exploits
The AI director does not simply check the remaining health, missed shots, etc.
It checks what caused the health loss, what is the player shooting at and if there are enemies in the level.
For example:

What caused the player to lose health?
What is the player actually shooting at?
Are there enemies present in the level?

title: AI Director in Games
text:
AI Director in open-world games
The AI Director is also used in open-world games.
If the player gets really far away from an NPC, then the NPC is now a waste of resources for the player’s platform.
It is responsible for spawning and de-spawning NPCs as the player explores the world.
By checking the player’s heading and speed, the AI Director can make sure no NPC pops up in front of the player.
